description: The autonomy.granted event (S56 T6, R5): published by the socket handler AFTER the store commits — at-most-once by design, as task.changed. The payload carries ids only: the grant id and the root it sits under; a subscriber that races the event reads the full row through autonomy.show, so the event is the signal, not the record. It is filed under the node's workspace root (componentRoot), so a subscriber filtered by Filter{ComponentRoot} gets one project's authority changes. No notify hint: widening the closed hint set is S58's (R5).
